Weakness.Name: DEPRECATED: Insecure Temporary File
Weakness.Description: This entry has been deprecated. It was focused only on the affected resource (temporary file) and not the behavior or mistake that produced the insecure temporary file, which caused confusion and incorrect mappings.

Weakness.Name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
Weakness.Description: Opening temporary files without appropriate measures or controls can leave the file, its contents and any function that it impacts vulnerable to attack.

Weakness.Name: Creation of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions
Weakness.Description: The product creates a temporary file in a directory whose permissions allow unintended actors to determine the file's existence or otherwise access that file.

Weakness.Name: Improper Control of a Resource Through its Lifetime
Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
